A1.justification: Both PDFs describe R1-RE. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-C are readable and support comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original relation-classification experiments, training dynamics, cross-task evaluations, and training-data augmentation results in Section 4.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments, including the model comparisons and supplementary evaluations in Tables 3-5.

M1.justification: Section 3.3 corrects the specified reward-combination rule: v1 uses r_format - 2 when r_format = -1; v2 returns r_format when r_format != 1. GRPO, prompting, component reward values, and the appendix TE design remain unchanged. This establishes a specification correction, not an implementation change or retraining.

E1.justification: All datasets and benchmarks are retained, but Table 1 changes both RC datasets from 19 to 17 classes without explaining whether evaluated label coverage changed. The MDKG annotation guide is unchanged; v1 lacks a complete Sem2010 label inventory, preventing resolution of coverage change versus reporting correction.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains the same Claude, GPT, Qwen2.5, Llama-3-8B, and SFT comparators. Comparator membership in the cross-task and additional-training-data comparisons also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Table 1 revises the stated class counts from 19 to 17 for both datasets, supported by the new Table 9. Train/test counts, zero-shot evaluation, prompts, and metrics are otherwise retained. This is a reported setting revision; neither PDF establishes that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The few-shot and prompt comparisons, training dynamics, reasoning case studies, cross-task capability evaluation, and Sem2018 augmentation analysis are retained with the same evidence in Figures 2 and 5-6 and Tables 4-5 and 7-8.

E5.justification: Both versions define Avg@4 using four sampled responses and retain identical plus/minus reporting in Table 3. No additional seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests are introduced.

E6.justification: Tables 3-5 retain all performance values, including the 65.8 and 66.5 cross-domain Avg@4 scores. The plotted results and qualitative case-study findings are also unchanged. New Table 9 reports dataset descriptions, not additional experimental outcomes.

T1.justification: The revised piecewise reward definition now covers the invalid-format value of -3, resolving v1's inconsistent condition requiring -1. The GRPO equations and appendix entity/triplet F1 definitions remain unchanged; no theorems or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The introduction refines the improvement claim from approximately 30% to up to +30 percentage points and specifies GPT-4o on MDKG as the proprietary-model comparison. Its additional contribution summaries and the new conclusion reiterate findings already present in v1.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning SFT memorization, RL generalization, possible benchmark leakage, human-like annotation, and capability retention are unchanged. Both versions retain the limitations concerning RC-focused evaluation and training only 7B-parameter models.

D1.justification: New Appendix A.3 and Table 9 provide explicit relation inventories and directionality information, especially for Sem2010, whose earlier description listed only examples. This improves dataset documentation without establishing changed data processing or adding training implementation details.

R1.justification: V2 adds Xie et al. (2021) on negative data in distantly supervised RE and removes Edge et al. (2024) and Luo et al. (2023), together with the introductory GraphRAG and graph-reasoning discussion. The central RLVR-for-RE positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 standardizes relationship to relation, adds an author, revises several introductory and methodological paragraphs, adds a conclusion and Appendix A.3, and numbers the related-work subsections. Most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds Table 9, shortens Table 2's guide excerpt while retaining its full content in Table 6, resizes Figure 6, and adjusts table placement and spacing. Existing graphical content and performance-table structures remain intact.

improvement.justification: V2 resolves an internally inconsistent reward definition, clarifies the headline improvement's units, and supplies explicit relation inventories. These provide modest gains in precision and reproducibility. The experimental evidence is unchanged, and the unexplained 19-to-17 class-count revision still leaves uncertainty about the evaluated label sets.
